# Shimmy Shake

Shimmy Shake is the fiery-haired earth pony cheerleader from G4's *Friendship is Magic*. Together with the blue mare Lighthoof, she leads the School of Friendship's cheer squad as a dancer. She's bubbly, speaks with a Valley Girl accent, and takes cheerleading seriously.

[![Shimmy Shake (right) and Lighthoof — Hasbro, Friendship is Magic](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2019/12/29/2232542.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/2232542)

- **Appearance:** Pale golden-yellow coat, coral-orange mane and tail with golden stripes, reddish-orange eyes, side-swept bangs and a ponytail. Her cutie mark depicts two pom-poms and a gust of wind. [Color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/504-Shimmy-Shake).
- **Name and voice:** Official on-screen name, not a fandom invention: she introduces herself in S9E15 and the [episode credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_nine) list Diana Kaarina as her English voice actor.
- **Naming curiosity:** In 2012, writer [Amy Keating Rogers revealed](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2012/07/smile-song-lyrics-by-amy-keating-rogers.html?hl=en) that her discarded Smile Song lyrics named Twist's mother Shimmy Shake. She explicitly said that detail was not canon; there is no verified connection between that proposed mother and the later cheerleader.
- **Appearances:** Her confirmed television role is *2, 4, 6, Greaaat* (S9E15, August 10, 2019). She is also a named character in [Gameloft's mobile game, as documented by the fan wiki](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares). No separate film or comic role was verified.

[![Shimmy Shake and Lighthoof — fan vector by dukeprincearmor](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2025/10/9/3623045/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/3623045)

## Important moments

All three scenes are from [2, 4, 6, Greaaat (S9E15)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/246-greaaat/umc.cmc.3xomscakf10q1twvuqxblrt44?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j). Video timestamps could not be verified; the linked episode and [dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/2%2C_4%2C_6%2C_Greaaat) cover the scenes.

- **Meet the lead dancers:** Shimmy introduces herself and Lighthoof to Rainbow Dash after their enthusiastic dance, establishing their commitment to the squad.
- **Standing up to their coach:** After a disastrous demonstration, Shimmy challenges Rainbow Dash's dismissive attitude and leaves with Lighthoof, making clear that their work deserves respect.
- **A successful halftime show:** The dancers finally coordinate with Yona, Ocellus and Smolder after Rainbow Dash begins coaching seriously, turning their individual talents into a spirited team performance.

Research limitation: Derpibooru's post appeared in image search and the image itself loaded, but direct access to the post returned 403. The transcript and credits were accessible through indexed excerpts; full-episode playback could not be checked.
